# Pink Cherry Nails & Spa

> Nail salon & spa based in Austin, Texas. Pink Cherry Nails & Spa near Lakeline is a clean, chill salon where Gina, Ashley, Sydney, Sarah and Jean turn your inspiration photo into acrylic, dip and builder gel sets, and remember you every visit.

- Phone: (512) 906-0178
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander
- Yelp rating: 4.4 from 225 reviews

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Pink Cherry Nails & Spa is on RR 620 North near Lakeline. Techs including Gina, Ashley, Jane, Jean, Theresa and sisters Sydney and Sarah do acrylic, SNS dip, builder gel and designs. Reviewers call it reliable and consistent: they remember regulars, make inspiration photos happen, and Spanish-speaking techs are on staff. Several clients have seen the same tech for five to seven years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Pink Cherry Nails & Spa?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 906-0178 or book online.
- Q: Where is Pink Cherry Nails & Spa?
  A: 12809 Ranch Rd 620 N, Ste 400, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Pink Cherry?
  A: Pink Cherry Nails & Spa is rated 4.4 stars from 225 Yelp reviews. Clients mention consistent techs who remember you, inspiration photos made real and a clean, chill shop.
